scope: Reviewer worklist only; not certification or signoff
evidenceStorage: Access-controlled external evidence vault, not GitHub

gates.test: Versioned maternal, newborn, emergency and child-care clinical source review and red-flag escalation; signed safety assessment.

gates.owner: Independent clinical expert and Kiswahili medical editor
gates.test: Review source-aligned medical translation, danger-sign semantics and controlled medical-content revisions.

gates.owner: Kenyan privacy lead and legal counsel
gates.test: ODPC, DPIA, children and guardians, lawful basis, retention, erasure, processor contracts, transfers and DHA certification applicability.
External penetration test, privileged RPCs, IDOR, auth session freshness, consent impersonation and remediation retest.
Verified production-like synthetic accounts, deny cross-owner/caregiver/child access, expiry, revocation and cleanup.

gates.owner: Authorized infrastructure and independent recovery engineer
gates.test: Real encrypted backup recovery into disposable isolated setup; verify Auth, database roles, RLS, functions; measured RTO/RPO.

gates.owner: Privacy lead and authorized database change owner
gates.test: Following signed restore, controlled v12 FK rollout review, rollback, recipient account deletion and final evidence.
Real iOS VoiceOver, Android TalkBack, desktop/tablet keyboard and 200–400 percent zoom signoff.

gates.owner: Named operations owner and incident-response lead
gates.test: Run incident drill, no-PHI monitoring, controlled SMTP, clinician escalation, support and rollback runbooks.

gates.owner: Independent clinical, privacy, security and release signatories
gates.test: Reconcile signed evidence and exact SHA/configuration, DHA/facility requirements; separate clinical activation PR.
